item.title: PHP Version with Known Vulnerabilities
item.description: The server disclosed the version of a server side technology it is running via an HTTP response header, and that version is affected by known vulnerabilities. The version, header and vulnerabilities, listed by severity, are given in the other info. See the references for the details of each. Note that some distributions backport security fixes without changing the version number, so check whether the fixes have actually been applied before reporting these as confirmed.

item.title: Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field(s)
item.description: The web/application server is leaking information via one or more “X-Powered-By” HTTP response headers. Access to such information may facilitate attackers identifying other frameworks/components your web application is reliant upon and the vulnerabilities such components may be subject to.

item.title: X-AspNet-Version Response Header
item.description: Server leaks information via “X-AspNet-Version”/“X-AspNetMvc-Version” HTTP response header field(s).
